items.reason: Inclusion requires 'high-grade primary glial brain tumor (WHO grade III and IV)': grade 4 explicitly allowed, no IDH requirement, glioblastoma not named in conditions/title/inclusion/arm labels. D30-R7 includes this as historical glioblastoma.

Coder A's doubt (GBM named only in the exclusion 'Recurrent GBM' and the description) is resolved by D30-R7: 'WHO grade III and IV' glioma with no IDH requirement is included as historical glioblastoma.

Rule 2 makes an anaesthetic a candidate when the record states an antitumour hypothesis; here 'propofol based anesthesia may limit the progression of brain cancer progression' and PFS/OS are outcomes.

Propofol maintenance is the only investigational agent in the 'Propofol group' arm, tested against sevoflurane with a stated antitumour rationale ('propofol seems to inhibit cancer formation steps'); rule 2 exception, then rule 4.
D30-R7 assigns cns5_terminology historical to 'WHO grade III and IV' glioma without IDH requirement; manual C8 also counts grade IV glioma without IDH as historical.

note: Registered phase is NA, so the trial fails S3 ([CODE], phase_not_applicable) regardless of these LLM codings. Propofol is also given as an induction bolus in both arms; the candidate row refers to propofol maintenance in the Propofol group (sevoflurane = control_comparator). Rocuronium naming (rocuronium vs rocuronium bromide) is a priority-3 item: INN parent is rocuronium.
